description: The workloads document a writer's configuration names as `workloads`: the issuers trusted to say which workload is publishing, and which source each speaks for.

apiVersion.description: The version of this document's shape, `audit.truvity.com/workloads/v1`. Absent is the same; another value is refused, so that a later shape arrives by a version and not by a file that quietly means something else.

issuers.description: The issuers whose tokens name a workload. At least one: a writer with none could never admit anybody.

audience.description: The audience a token from this issuer must carry.

url.description: The issuer's URL, as a token's `iss` claim names it.

workloads.description: The service accounts that publish, and the source each speaks for.

issuer.description: The issuer the subject belongs to. Required when more than one issuer is trusted.

source.description: The catalogue source the workload may record for.

subject.description: The token's subject: in a cluster, `system:serviceaccount:<namespace>:<name>`.

title: audit workloads
